status_note: Starter register — illustrative desk pass (22 Aug 2026). Entries are real initiatives; every row is to be verified to the Source-Tier Protocol before circulation. T5 rows evidence existence only.

entries.name: NIDAP — National Integrated Digital Agriculture Platform
entries.lead: FMAFS — Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security
entries.scale: Early rollout; aims to harmonize value chains and farmer registries

entries.name: National Digital Agriculture Strategy 2020–2030 (NDAS)
entries.lead: FMAFS, with FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization) and ITU (International Telecommunication Union) support
entries.scale: Policy blueprint — drafted 2020, not formally adopted

entries.name: Growth Enhancement Support / e-Wallet (GES)
entries.lead: FMARD (Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, predecessor ministry) + Cellulant
entries.results: Independent studies report input-access and yield gains; network failures and elite capture also documented
entries.src: Peer-reviewed evaluations of GES; program records

entries.name: Anchor Borrowers' Programme (ABP)
entries.results: Rice output gains claimed by CBN; low repayment rates documented

entries.name: NIRSAL — Nigeria Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending
entries.results: Credit risk-sharing operational; smallholder awareness reported low

entries.name: FADAMA III (floodplain agriculture program)
entries.results: Income gains documented in project completion reporting

entries.name: SAPZ — Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zones
entries.lead: AfDB (African Development Bank) + federal and state governments
entries.scale: Phase 1 in implementation across participating states
entries.results: Early implementation; no outcome evidence yet

entries.name: NiMet climate advisories / DCAS (Digital Climate Advisory Services)
entries.scale: National seasonal predictions; rural penetration reported limited
entries.results: Annual Seasonal Climate Prediction (SCP) institutionalized; last-mile reach is the gap

entries.name: Hello Tractor
entries.scale: Tractor-booking marketplace; deployments documented by GSMA (the mobile-industry association)
entries.results: GSMA case documentation of booking model

overlap_finding: Farmer registration is the register's structural overlap: GES (closed) enrolled 4.5M+, ABP (closed) 4M+, and private platforms report millions more — yet the national registry (indicator 3.3) records ~279k farmers, under 1% of farming households. Enrollment has happened repeatedly in program silos; a registry has not.
